label: decision_window_diagnosis
issue: blocker for fly-ky7.11 and the confirmatory series
root_cause: The protocol pre-registers a 30 ms decision window at dt = 1.0 ms, i.e. 30 steps (spec line 330). Commit 7dd3bd6 cut dt to 0.1 ms for the Shiu parameterisation but left the step count at 30, silently shortening the window to 3 ms. t_delay = 1.8 ms = 18 steps, so a 30-step window fits ONE synaptic hop and a second-hop spike would arrive at step 36, past the end of the window.

at_30_steps_drive_0.06.note: not even the 1042 directly driven input neurons fired; max current 0.030 mV against a 7.0 mV gap

at_30_steps_drive_20.note: identical counts: zero non-input neurons ever fired, so there was no propagation at all

structure_is_fine.note: anatomy can drive the outputs four times over; the presynaptic neurons simply never fire

weight_is_not_the_lever.note: raising the one fitted free parameter a hundredfold still left median output s.d. at zero

consequence_for_A4: A4's verification table recorded median s.d. 70.10 / 13.72 / 4.88, a 14x spread with real on top. At a shared absolute w_syn and a working window the spread is 11 percent (0.5194 / 0.4946 / 0.4659). The large pre-learning ordering A4 recorded was produced by the per-arm branching calibration (real 143.3, shuffled 40.7, random 38.2), which commit 7dd3bd6 removed as a confound. The direction survives; the magnitude does not.
consequence_for_fly-ky7.11: The amplitude confound that motivated the issue is roughly 11 percent, not 1400 percent. The control is still worth running, but it is now a check rather than a rescue, and a learning difference can no longer be dismissed as 'real simply transmits more'.

cost.scaling: exactly linear in steps (14.6 s at 30 steps), so the corrected window multiplies every training estimate by 10
cost.note: batch 32 at 300 steps did not complete in 7 GB of RAM; the spec's 250 MB BPTT estimate (line 336) assumed 8k neurons and 30 steps, and becomes roughly 4.8 GB at 15.4k neurons, batch 64 and 300 steps -- still inside 12 GB but with far less headroom
cost.open_question: the pre-registered confirmatory budget (5e5 steps x 10 seeds x 3 arms) was estimated at 466 h on an M1 Pro at the broken 30-step window; at 300 steps that becomes roughly 4700 h. Raising dt (the integration uses the exact linear solution, not Euler, so the cost of a coarser dt is spike-time quantisation rather than instability) would buy the window back proportionally and is worth measuring before committing to the series.

fix: DECISION_WINDOW_MS = 30.0 with the step count derived from ShiuParams.dt_ms, so a future dt change moves the step count instead of shortening the window. INPUT_DRIVE_MV restored to 20.0. Regression tests in tests/test_decision_window.py.
